book_name: 全新版大学进阶英语视听说教程2

chapters.name: Unit 1 Part II Lesson A New Words and Expressions

words.ex: He is learning elementary math at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习初级数学。
words.en: Elementary means relating to the simplest and most basic aspects of a subject.

words.tr:
n. 未来；将来；前途；
adj. 将来的；未来的；
words.ex: We cannot predict the future.
words.ex_cn: 我们无法预测未来。
words.en: The future is the time after the present, or the events that will happen then.

words.ex: He lives in Kenya.
words.ex_cn: 他住在肯尼亚。
words.en: A country in East Africa known for its scenic landscapes and vast wildlife preserves.

words.ex: The lawyer helps people with legal problems.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助人们解决法律问题。
words.en: A lawyer is a person who is qualified to advise people about the law and represent them in court.

words.tr:
n. 返回；归还；
v. 返回；归还；
words.ex: The return of the train was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 火车的返回被推迟了。
words.en: To go or come back to a place or person. To give, send, or put something back to its original place or condition.

chapters.name: Unit 1 Part II Lesson B New Words and Expressions

words.tr:
n. 专家；行家；
adj. 内行的；老练的；专门的；
words.ex: He is an expert in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他是计算机科学方面的专家。
words.en: A person who is very knowledgeable about or skillful in a particular area.

words.ex: He lives independently and makes his own decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他独立生活，并自己做决定。
words.en: If one thing or person is independent of another, they are separate and not connected, so that the first one is not affected or influenced by the second.

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful instrument for building.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是建造时有用的工具。
words.en: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular task, especially for scientific, medical, or technical work. It can also refer to a musical instrument.

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.tr:
n. 节目；程序；
v. 编程；
words.ex: We watched a funny program on TV last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在电视上看了一个有趣的节目。
words.en: A program is a set of instructions that a computer follows in order to perform a particular task.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.tr:
adj. 特别的；特殊的；
n. 特价；特色菜；专车；特别的物品；
words.ex: This is a special day for me.
words.ex_cn: 这一天对我来说很特别。
words.en: Something that is special is different from normal things, or is considered to be better than normal things.

words.tr:
n. 状态；州；国家；
v. 陈述；说明；
adj. 国事礼仪（或规格）的；州的；
words.ex: The state of the car is very poor.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的状态非常差。
words.en: A state is a condition or way of being that something or someone is in. It can also refer to a nation or territory considered as an organized political community under one government.

chapters.name: Unit 1 Part III New Words and Expressions

words.ex: She is a successful businesswoman.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位成功的女商人。
words.en: A businesswoman is a woman who works in business, especially one who has a high position in a company.

words.ex: My generation grew up with smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 我们这一代人是伴随着智能手机长大的。
words.en: A generation is all the people in a group or country who are of a similar age, especially when they are considered as having the same experiences or attitudes.

words.tr: n. 约翰内斯堡（南非最大的城市）
words.ex: He lives in Johannesburg.
words.ex_cn: 他住在约翰内斯堡。
words.en: Johannesburg is the largest city in South Africa and is known for its rich history and culture.

words.ex: He is lucky to win the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他很幸运赢得了奖品。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as lucky, you mean that they have something which is very desirable or that they are in a very desirable situation.

words.tr: n. 街坊；四邻；街道；附近地区；
words.ex: I walk my dog in the neighborhood every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上在街坊遛狗。
words.en: A neighborhood is one of the parts of a town where people live.

words.tr: n. 水塘；水池；备用物资；美式撞球；
words.ex: The children play near the small pool.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在小水塘边玩耍。
words.en: A pool is a small area of still water, especially one that is artificially created.

words.ex: He keeps his diary private.
words.ex_cn: 他把日记保密。
words.en: If something is private, it is for the use of one person or group, rather than for the general public.

words.tr: n. 以临时搭盖的陋屋为主的地区
words.ex: The shantytown was a stark reminder of the city's poverty.
words.ex_cn: 这个棚户区是城市贫困的鲜明提醒。
words.en: A shantytown is a deprived area on the outskirts of a town consisting of large numbers of shanties.

words.ex: He lives in South Africa.
words.ex_cn: 他住在南非。
words.en: South Africa is a country located at the southern tip of the African continent, known for its diverse cultures, languages, and natural beauty.

words.ex: They live in a quiet suburb outside the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市外一个安静的市郊。
words.en: A suburb is a residential district located on the outskirts of a city.

words.tr: adj. 西方的；西洋的；西部的；
words.ex: He likes western music and movies.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢西方的音乐和电影。
words.en: Western means relating to the countries of the West, especially Europe and America.

chapters.name: Unit 2 Part II Lesson A New Words and Expressions

words.ex: He drinks bottled water every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝瓶装水。
words.en: Water that has been purified and sealed in bottles for drinking.

words.tr:
adj. 洁净的；干净的；
v. 打扫；使干净；
words.ex: The kitchen is clean after she wiped the counters.
words.ex_cn: 她擦了台面后，厨房变得洁净了。
words.en: If something is clean, it is free from dirt, marks, or unwanted substances.

words.tr:
n. 费用；代价；
v. 花费；
words.ex: The cost of the book is ten dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的费用是十美元。
words.en: The amount of money that you need in order to buy, make, or do something.

words.ex: The phone is expensive.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机很贵。
words.en: Costing a lot of money; having a high price.

words.tr:
n. 塑料；
adj. 塑料的；
words.ex: The bottle is made of plastic.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子是塑料做的。
words.en: A plastic is a material which is produced from oil by a chemical process and which is used to make many objects. It is light in weight and does not break easily.

words.ex: The planet Mars is red.
words.ex_cn: 火星是红色的。
words.en: A planet is a large object in space that moves around a star, such as the sun, and does not produce its own light.

words.tr:
v. 利用；
n. 水龙头；轻拍；轻敲；轻击；
words.ex: The company tapped local talent to grow its business.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司利用本地人才来发展业务。
words.en: If you tap something, you hit it with a quick light blow or a series of quick light blows. A tap is a device that controls the flow of a liquid or gas from a pipe or container, for example on a sink.

words.tr: n. 垃圾；无价值的东西；
words.ex: The trash bin is full.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾桶满了。
words.en: Waste material or unwanted things that are thrown away.

words.ex: Eating too much sugar is unhealthy.
words.ex_cn: 吃太多糖是不健康的。
words.en: If you describe something as unhealthy, you mean that it is likely to cause illness or poor health.

words.ex: It is wasteful to leave the lights on all day.
words.ex_cn: 整天开着灯是浪费的。
words.en: If you describe something as wasteful, you disapprove of it because it uses too much of something valuable, such as time, money, or energy.

chapters.name: Unit 2 Part II Lesson B New Words and Expressions

words.ex: He wants to visit Africa next year.
words.ex_cn: 他想明年去非洲旅行。
words.en: Africa is the continent south of Europe, between the Atlantic Ocean and the Indian Ocean.

words.tr:
adj. 非洲的；非洲人的；
n. 非洲人；
words.ex: He loves African music and dance.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢非洲的音乐和舞蹈。
words.en: Relating to Africa or its people, culture, or languages.

words.ex: He traveled to Arabia last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了阿拉伯。
words.en: A large peninsula in Southwest Asia, bounded by the Red Sea on the west, the Persian Gulf on the east, and the Arabian Sea on the south.

words.ex: He is traveling to Brazil next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月要去巴西旅行。
words.en: Brazil is a country in South America, known for its vast Amazon rainforest and vibrant culture.

words.tr:
adj. 特别受喜爱的；
n. 特别喜爱的事物；
words.ex: Chocolate is my favourite dessert.
words.ex_cn: 巧克力是我最喜爱的甜点。
words.en: Something or someone that is preferred above all others.

words.ex: Do you want to go out tonight? Nope.
words.ex_cn: 你今晚想出去吗？不。
words.en: Used to give a negative response or to refuse something.

words.tr: adj. 严重的；认真的；严肃的；
words.ex: The accident caused a serious injury.
words.ex_cn: 这次事故造成了严重的伤害。
words.en: If you are serious about something, you are sincere about it and mean what you say.

chapters.name: Unit 2 Part III New Words and Expressions

words.tr: adj. 令人惊异的；令人惊叹的； v. “amaze”的现在分词；
words.ex: The view from the mountain is amazing.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色令人惊异。
words.en: If something is amazing, it is very surprising and makes you feel pleasure or admiration.

words.tr: adj. 某个；确定的；一定的；一定程度上的；
words.ex: I saw a certain man near the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园附近看到某个男人。
words.en: If you are certain about something, you have no doubt about it.

words.tr:
n. 挑战；
v. 提出挑战；
words.ex: Climbing that mountain is a big challenge.
words.ex_cn: 爬那座山是一个巨大的挑战。
words.en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

words.ex: She wore a dress made of cotton.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件棉质裙子。
words.en: Cotton is a plant that produces a soft fiber which is used to make cloth or thread. Cotton is also the cloth or thread that is made from this fiber.

words.tr:
n. 循环；周期；自行车；
v. 骑自行车；循环；
words.ex: The water cycle is important for nature.
words.ex_cn: 水循环对自然界很重要。
words.en: A cycle is a series of events that are regularly repeated in the same order or a bicycle.

words.ex: The sun makes the puddle evaporate quickly.
words.ex_cn: 太阳使水坑很快蒸发。
words.en: If a liquid evaporates, or if something evaporates it, it changes from a liquid state to a gas, because its temperature has increased.

words.tr: adj. 新鲜的；新的；刚发生的；
words.ex: She bought fresh apples from the market.
words.ex_cn: 她从市场买了新鲜的苹果。
words.en: Fresh food has been picked or produced recently, and has not been preserved, for example by being frozen or put in a tin.

words.tr: n. 恒河（印度北部的一条主要河流）
words.ex: The Ganges is considered sacred by Hindus.
words.ex_cn: 恒河被印度教徒视为神圣的河流。
words.en: The Ganges is a major river in the Indian subcontinent flowing east through the plains of northern India into Bangladesh. It is considered sacred by Hindus and is worshipped as the goddess Ganga in Hinduism.

words.ex: He wears a helmet to protect his head.
words.ex_cn: 他戴头盔来保护头部。
words.en: If you protect someone or something, you prevent them from being harmed or damaged.

words.ex: He is thirsty after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后口渴了。
words.en: If you are thirsty, you feel a need to drink something.

words.ex: He wears a red t-shirt every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿一件红色T恤。
words.en: A T-shirt is a casual shirt with short sleeves and no collar, typically made of cotton.

words.ex: The doctor said the patient needs urgent care.
words.ex_cn: 医生说病人需要紧急治疗。
words.en: If something is urgent, it needs to be dealt with as soon as possible.

chapters.name: Unit 3 Part II Lesson A New Words and Expressions

words.ex: We ordered a plate of ceviche as an appetizer.
words.ex_cn: 我们点了一盘酸橘汁腌鱼作为开胃菜。
words.en: Ceviche is a dish consisting of fresh raw fish cured in citrus juices, such as lemon or lime, and spiced with ají or chili peppers.

words.ex: He eats chili with rice every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃辣椒配米饭。
words.en: Chili is a small, hot-tasting pod of a type of pepper, used in cooking to add flavor and heat to dishes.

words.tr: adj. 硬脆的；爽脆的；松脆的；嘎吱作响的；
words.ex: The apple is crunchy and sweet.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果硬脆且甜美。
words.en: Something that is crunchy is firm and makes a sharp sound when you bite or crush it.

words.ex: The grasshopper jumps high in the grass.
words.ex_cn: 蚱蜢在草丛中跳得很高。
words.en: A grasshopper is a plant-eating insect with long back legs that can jump very high and makes a sharp, high noise using its back legs or wings.

words.ex: The gross income of the company is $5 million.
words.ex_cn: 公司的总收入是500万美元。
words.en: If you describe something as gross, you mean it is very obvious, unacceptable, or unpleasant.

words.tr: phrase. 拉丁美洲（指美国以南、以拉丁语系语言为主要官方语言的地区，包括墨西哥、中美洲、南美洲及加勒比海部分地区）
words.ex: He travels to Latin America every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都去拉丁美洲旅行。
words.en: Latin America refers to the region of the Americas where Romance languages, particularly Spanish and Portuguese, are primarily spoken. It includes countries in Central America, South America, and the Caribbean.

words.ex: Farmers spread lime on the soil to make it less acidic.
words.ex_cn: 农民在土壤上撒石灰以降低其酸性。
words.en: Lime is a white substance obtained by heating limestone, used in making cement and in farming to improve soil. It is also a small green fruit that is similar to a lemon.

words.ex: She added a mint leaf to her drink.
words.ex_cn: 她在饮料里加了一片薄荷叶。
words.en: Mint is a plant with fresh-tasting leaves. It is also the place where coins are made, or the act of making coins.

words.tr:
adj. 摩洛哥的
n. 摩洛哥人
words.ex: The Moroccan market is full of vibrant colors and exotic spices.
words.ex_cn: 摩洛哥市场充满了鲜艳的色彩和异国情调的香料。
words.en: Moroccan refers to something or someone that is from Morocco, a country in North Africa, or relates to its culture, people, or language.

words.ex: She added pepper to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她往汤里加了胡椒粉。
words.en: Pepper is a hot-tasting powder made from the crushed seeds of certain plants, used to flavor food.

words.tr: adj. 未加工处理过的；生的；
words.ex: He eats raw vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃未加工的蔬菜。
words.en: Raw refers to something that is in its natural state and not processed or cooked.

words.tr: adj. 使人精神焕发的； v. “refresh”的现在分词；
words.ex: The cool breeze was refreshing after the hot walk.
words.ex_cn: 在炎热的散步之后，凉爽的微风使人精神焕发。
words.en: Something that is refreshing is pleasantly different and interesting.

words.ex: The soup is too salty.
words.ex_cn: 这汤太咸了。
words.en: Something that is salty contains salt or tastes of salt.

words.ex: I ate an apple as a snack after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后吃了一个苹果当小吃。
words.en: A snack is a small amount of food that is eaten between meals.

words.ex: The soup is too spicy for me.
words.ex_cn: 这汤对我来说太辣了。
words.en: Food that is spicy has a strong, hot flavor.

words.tr: adj. 有浓烈气味的；扑鼻的；有刺激性的
words.ex: The lemonade has a tangy taste.
words.ex_cn: 柠檬水有酸味。
words.en: A tangy flavor is pleasantly strong and sharp.

words.ex: The soup is tasty and hot.
words.ex_cn: 这汤美味又热。
words.en: If you describe food as tasty, you mean that it has a pleasant and attractive flavour.

words.ex: He traveled to Vietnam last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了越南。
words.en: Vietnam is a country in Southeast Asia, known for its beaches, rivers, Buddhist pagodas, and bustling cities.

words.ex: The cake is yummy.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕很好吃。
words.en: If you describe food as yummy, you mean that it tastes extremely good.

chapters.name: Unit 3 Part II Lesson B New Words and Expressions

words.tr: n. 自助餐厅；自助食堂；
words.ex: We ate lunch in the school cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 我们在学校自助餐厅吃午饭。
words.en: A cafeteria is a type of food service location within an institution in which there is little or no waiting staff table service, whether a restaurant or within an institution such as a large office building or school; a school dining location is also referred to as a dining hall or canteen (in British English).

words.tr:
adj. 公平的；相当大的；合理的；
n. 集市；
words.ex: The teacher gave a fair grade to every student.
words.ex_cn: 老师给每个学生都给了一个公平的分数。
words.en: Fair means treating people equally without favouritism or discrimination.

words.tr: phrase. 自动售货机；自动贩卖机
words.ex: He bought a soda from the vending machine.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动售货机买了一罐苏打水。
words.en: A vending machine is a machine from which you can get things such as cigarettes, chocolate, or coffee by putting in money and pressing a button.

chapters.name: Unit 3 Part III New Words and Expressions

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.ex: Sugar is an ingredient in this cake.
words.ex_cn: 糖是这个蛋糕的一个成分。
words.en: An ingredient is one of the substances that are combined to make something, especially in cooking.

words.ex: The landscape after the rain is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 雨后的景色非常美丽。
words.en: A landscape is all the visible features of an area of land, often considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal.

words.tr: n. 澳门（中国特别行政区）
words.ex: He visited Macao last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了澳门。
words.en: Macao is a Special Administrative Region of China, known for its casinos and Portuguese colonial architecture.

words.ex: He picked a wild mushroom in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在森林里摘了一朵野生蘑菇。
words.en: A mushroom is a fungus that grows in damp, dark places and has a stem with a rounded top.

words.tr:
v. 保存；保护；保持；
n. （某群体）专有的活动；
words.ex: She preserves fresh fruit by making jam.
words.ex_cn: 她通过做果酱来保存新鲜水果。
words.en: To preserve something means to maintain it in its original or existing state.

words.ex: He lives in Singapore.
words.ex_cn: 他住在新加坡。
words.en: A country in Southeast Asia, known for its multicultural society, strict laws, and as a global financial hub.

chapters.name: Unit 4 Part II Lesson A New Words and Expressions

words.ex: He is a blogger who writes about food.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位写美食的博主。
words.en: A blogger is someone who writes regularly for an online journal or website.

words.ex: Children laughed as the firework lit up the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看着焰火点亮夜空，哈哈大笑。
words.en: A firework is a small device that is lit to produce a display of light, noise, and smoke, often used in celebrations.

words.ex: He gave his mother a massage after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后给妈妈做了按摩。
words.en: The act of rubbing and pressing someone's body with the hands to reduce tension or pain in the muscles.

words.tr: phrase. 泥浆节；一种以玩泥巴为主要活动的节日
words.ex: The annual Mud Festival attracts thousands of tourists to Boryeong.
words.ex_cn: 一年一度的泥浆节吸引了成千上万的游客来到保宁市。
words.en: A Mud Festival is an event where people gather to play and celebrate in mud, often featuring mud wrestling, mud sliding, and other mud-based activities.

words.tr:
n. 游行；阅兵；
v. 游行；阅兵；
words.ex: The city held a big parade on Independence Day.
words.ex_cn: 城市在独立日举行了盛大的游行。
words.en: A parade is a procession of people or vehicles moving through a public place in order to celebrate an important day or event.

words.ex: She wears a swimsuit at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 她在海滩上穿泳衣。
words.en: A swimsuit is a piece of clothing that is worn for swimming, especially by women and girls.

chapters.name: Unit 4 Part II Lesson B New Words and Expressions

words.tr:
n. 哔哔声；嘟嘟声；蜂鸣声
v. 发出哔哔声；发出嘟嘟声
words.ex: The microwave gave a loud beep when the food was ready.
words.ex_cn: 微波炉当食物准备好时发出了一声哔哔声。
words.en: A short, high-pitched sound emitted by electronic equipment or a vehicle horn as a signal or warning.

words.ex: The entrance to the building is on the left.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的入口在左边。
words.en: An entrance is a way into a place, such as a door or gate. It can also refer to the act of entering a place or the right to enter.

words.tr: phrase. 北滩节（美国旧金山北滩社区举办的年度街头艺术节）
words.ex: The North Beach Festival in San Francisco is a popular event featuring arts, music, and food.
words.ex_cn: 旧金山的北滩节是一个受欢迎的活动，以艺术、音乐和美食为特色。
words.en: The North Beach Festival is an annual celebration that highlights the cultural and historical significance of the North Beach area, featuring various activities, performances, and exhibitions.

chapters.name: Unit 4 Part III New Words and Expressions

words.ex: The bang woke me up at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 那声巨响在午夜把我吵醒了。
words.en: A bang is a sudden loud noise such as the noise of an explosion.

words.ex: He lit a candle to see in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他点燃了一支蜡烛以便在黑暗中看见。
words.en: A candle is a stick of wax with a wick through the middle which is lit to give light as it burns.

words.ex: We decorate the room for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我们为派对装饰房间。
words.en: To make something look more attractive by putting things on it or around it.

words.tr: n. （Dawali）排灯节（印度教秋季节日）; n. （Dawali）迭华里（人名）
words.ex: The festival of Diwali is celebrated with great enthusiasm in India.
words.ex_cn: 排灯节在印度以极大的热情庆祝。
words.en: Diwali is a Hindu festival of lights, celebrated every autumn in the northern hemisphere.

words.ex: The temple is a Hindu place of worship.
words.ex_cn: 这座寺庙是印度教的礼拜场所。
words.en: A Hindu is a person who follows Hinduism, the main religion of India.

words.ex: She smells the jasmine in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 她在花园里闻着茉莉花的香味。
words.en: A shrub or climbing plant which bears fragrant flowers used in perfumery or tea.

words.ex: The lotus grows in the muddy pond.
words.ex_cn: 莲花生长在泥泞的池塘里。
words.en: A lotus is a type of water lily with large, flat leaves and white, pink, or yellow flowers. It is often regarded as a symbol of purity and enlightenment in various cultures.

words.tr: n. （印度传统地画艺术）蓝果丽
words.ex: She makes a colorful rangoli on the floor for Diwali.
words.ex_cn: 她为排灯节在地板上画了一个五彩缤纷的罗恩吉利。
words.en: Rangoli is a form of Indian folk art in which patterns are created on the floor in living rooms or courtyards using materials such as colored rice, dry flour, colored sand or flower petals.

words.ex: They rejoice when the sun comes out.
words.ex_cn: 当太阳出来时，他们欢呼。
words.en: To feel or show great joy or delight.

words.ex: We woke up early to see the sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 我们早起看日出。
words.en: The time in the morning when the sun appears or full daylight arrives.

chapters.name: Unit 5 Part II Lesson A New Words and Expressions

words.tr: n. 安哥拉绒（一种在尼日利亚和西非国家流行的面料）；（Ankara）安卡拉（土耳其首都）
words.ex: She lives in Ankara.
words.ex_cn: 她住在安卡拉。
words.en: Ankara is the capital city of Turkey, located in the central part of the country.

words.ex: The river forms the border between the two countries.
words.ex_cn: 这条河是两个国家的边界。
words.en: The edge or boundary of something, or the part near it; a dividing line.

words.ex: Asia is the largest continent.
words.ex_cn: 亚洲是最大的洲。
words.en: A continent is a very large area of land, such as Africa or Asia, that consists of several countries.

words.ex: The cake tastes delicious.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕味道很美味。
words.en: If you describe food or drink as delicious, you mean that it has a very pleasant taste.

words.tr: n. （Harajuku）原宿（日本东京涉谷区的一个地方）
words.ex: She loves shopping in Harajuku.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢在原宿购物。
words.en: Harajuku is a district in Tokyo, Japan, famous for its unique fashion styles and youth culture.

words.tr: n. 伊斯坦布尔（土耳其城市）
words.ex: He lives in Istanbul.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伊斯坦布尔。
words.en: Istanbul is a major city in Turkey that straddles Europe and Asia across the Bosphorus Strait. Its Old City reflects cultural influences of the many empires that once ruled here.

words.tr: phrase. 香料市场；售卖香料的集市
words.ex: We walked through the spice bazaar and smelled many herbs.
words.ex_cn: 我们走过香料市场，闻到了许多香草的味道。
words.en: A spice bazaar is a market where a variety of spices are sold. It is a place where one can find different kinds of herbs, spices, and sometimes other goods related to cooking and traditional medicine.

words.ex: She wears trendy clothes to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着时髦的衣服去参加派对。
words.en: If something is trendy, it is very fashionable and modern.

words.ex: We ate turkey for Thanksgiving dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们在感恩节晚餐上吃了火鸡。
words.en: A turkey is a large bird that is often eaten at Christmas or Thanksgiving.

words.tr: phrase. 旋转的苦行僧（指苏菲派穆斯林中以高速旋转舞蹈进行宗教冥想的修行者）；引申义为精力旺盛、不停旋转或忙碌的人
words.ex: The whirling dervish spins fast in the ancient ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 旋转的苦修者在古老的仪式中快速旋转。
words.en: A member of a Muslim religious order noted for its devotional exercises, which include spinning rapidly in place.

chapters.name: Unit 5 Part II Lesson B New Words and Expressions

words.tr:
n. 市中心区；商业区；
adv. 在市区；往市区；
words.ex: We went downtown to buy some clothes.
words.ex_cn: 我们去市中心买了一些衣服。
words.en: Downtown refers to the central part or main business and commercial area of a city or town.

words.ex: The electric lamp lights up the room.
words.ex_cn: 电灯照亮了房间。
words.en: Something that is electric works by means of electricity, is powered by electricity, or produces electricity.

words.ex: He paid the fee to join the club.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了加入俱乐部的费用。
words.en: A fee is a sum of money that you pay to be allowed to do something such as join an organization, or to be given advice or a service.

words.tr:
adj. 有规律的；经常的；常见的；
n. 常客；
words.ex: He goes for a run every morning, a regular habit.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步，这是一个有规律的习惯。
words.en: Something that is regular happens or is done at equal intervals or is consistent in pattern or occurrence.

chapters.name: Unit 5 Part III New Words and Expressions

words.ex: The adventurer climbed the high mountain alone.
words.ex_cn: 这位冒险家独自爬上了高山。
words.en: An adventurer is someone who enjoys or seeks adventure, especially someone who travels to unknown or dangerous places.

words.ex: He is the author of this book.
words.ex_cn: 他是这本书的作者。
words.en: An author is a person who writes books, stories, or articles, especially as a job.

words.ex: The child blew a bubble with gum.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用口香糖吹了一个气泡。
words.en: A bubble is a small ball of air or gas in a liquid, or a ball of air inside a solid substance such as glass.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.ex: The puppy is cute.
words.ex_cn: 这只小狗很可爱。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as cute, you mean that they are attractive, often in a childlike or youthful way.

words.ex: He loves geography and learns about countries and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢地理学，学习各国和河流的知识。
words.en: The study of the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these, including the distribution of populations and resources, land use, and industries.

words.tr: n. 栖息地；居留地；产地；
words.ex: The panda's habitat is in the mountains of China.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的栖息地在中国的山区。
words.en: The natural environment in which a species or group of species lives.

words.ex: Her story inspires me to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 她的故事激励我更加努力。
words.en: If someone or something inspires you to do something new or unusual, they make you want to do it.

words.tr: n. 孟买（印度西部港市）
words.ex: He lives in Mumbai with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他和家人住在孟买。
words.en: Mumbai is a major city in India, known for its financial, commercial, and entertainment industries.

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

chapters.name: Unit 6 Part II Lesson A New Words and Expressions

words.tr: adj. 航空的；航空学的；飞机驾驶员的（等于 aeronautic）
words.ex: He designs aeronautical systems for airplanes.
words.ex_cn: 他为飞机设计航空系统。
words.en: Relating to the science or practice of building or flying aircraft.

words.tr: n. 航空；航空学；飞行（术）；
words.ex: He works in aviation as a pilot.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名飞行员从事航空工作。
words.en: Aviation is the operation and production of aircraft.

words.tr: n. 飞机座舱；赛车座舱；
words.ex: The pilot checked the instruments in the cockpit.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员在飞机座舱里检查了仪表。
words.en: The compartment where the pilot sits in an aircraft, from which the aircraft is controlled.

words.ex: He works for a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司工作。
words.en: A company is a business organization that makes money by producing or selling goods or services.

words.ex: The customer bought a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 这位客户买了一部新手机。
words.en: A customer is someone who buys goods or services from a shop or business.

words.tr: n. 企业家；创业者；承包人；
words.ex: He is an entrepreneur who started a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位创办了小型咖啡店的企业家。
words.en: An entrepreneur is a person who organizes and operates a business or businesses, taking on greater than normal financial risks in order to do so.

words.tr:
n. 经验；阅历；
v. 经历；体验；
words.ex: He has a lot of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有丰富的英语教学经验。
words.en: Experience is knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity that you have gained because you have done that job or activity for a long time.

words.tr: n. 航班；飞行；（阶梯的）一段；
words.ex: The flight to Beijing leaves at 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 飞往北京的航班早上8点起飞。
words.en: A flight is a journey made by flying, usually in an aircraft.

words.ex: The painting gave me inspiration.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画给了我灵感。
words.en: Inspiration is a feeling of enthusiasm you get from someone or something, which gives you new and creative ideas.

words.ex: He lives in Miami with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他和家人住在迈阿密。
words.en: A city in southeastern Florida, known for its beaches and as a center of Latin American culture.

words.ex: The pilot landed the plane safely.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员安全地降落了飞机。
words.en: A pilot is a person who operates the flying controls of an aircraft. Also, to pilot something means to test or introduce a new idea, product, etc., to see if it will be successful.

words.tr:
adj. 专业的；职业的；
n. 专业人士；
words.ex: He is a professional teacher with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有多年经验的专业教师。
words.en: A professional is a person who has a job that requires special training and education, especially one that involves a high level of skill or knowledge.

words.tr: adj. 单独的；独唱的；独奏的；
words.ex: He played a solo guitar piece at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他在音乐会上演奏了一首独奏吉他曲。
words.en: A solo is a piece of music or a performance done by one person alone, without any accompaniment.

chapters.name: Unit 6 Part II Lesson B New Words and Expressions

words.tr:
v. 敢说；
n. 打赌；赌注；
words.ex: I bet you didn't know that.
words.ex_cn: 我敢说你不知道那件事。
words.en: If you bet on the result of a horse race, football game, or other event, you give someone a sum of money which they give you back with extra money if the result is what you predicted, or which they keep if it is not.

words.ex: Someday, I will visit Paris.
words.ex_cn: 有朝一日，我会去巴黎。
words.en: At some time in the future.

words.ex: He wore a weird hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶怪异的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as weird, you mean that they are strange, unusual, or mysterious.

chapters.name: Unit 6 Part III New Words and Expressions

words.tr:
v. 沐浴；用水洗；沉浸
n. 游泳
words.ex: He bathes every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上洗澡。
words.en: To bathe means to wash oneself or someone else, especially in a bath or the sea, or to spend time in water for pleasure.

words.tr: n. 博茨瓦纳（非洲国家）
words.ex: He lives in Botswana.
words.ex_cn: 他住在博茨瓦纳。
words.en: A landlocked country in Southern Africa known for its wildlife, mineral resources, and being one of the world's largest producers of diamonds.

words.tr:
v. 记录；准确地描述；俘虏；吸引；
n. 抓捕；
words.ex: The camera can capture the moment clearly.
words.ex_cn: 相机可以清晰地记录下这一瞬间。
words.en: To capture someone or something means to catch them, especially after a chase.

words.tr:
n. 伪装；伪装物；
v. 伪装；掩饰；
words.ex: He wore a hat and glasses as a disguise.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了帽子和眼镜作为伪装。
words.en: To disguise means to change your appearance or behavior so that people will not recognize you, or to make something seem different from what it really is.

words.tr: v. 使遭危险或伤害；危害；危及
words.ex: Pollution can endanger animals.
words.ex_cn: 污染会危及动物。
words.en: To put someone or something at risk or in danger.

words.tr:
n. 兽群；
v. 放牧；
words.ex: The herd of cows walked slowly to the pasture.
words.ex_cn: 一群牛缓缓走向牧场。
words.en: A herd is a large group of animals of one kind that live together.

words.ex: The lioness hunts for her cubs every day.
words.ex_cn: 母狮每天为她的幼崽捕猎。
words.en: A lioness is a female lion.

words.tr: n. 掠夺者；捕食性动物；食肉动物；
words.ex: The lion is a predator that hunts deer.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种捕食鹿的掠夺者。
words.en: A predator is an animal that naturally preys on others.

words.ex: The park protects many kinds of wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护许多种类的野生生物。
words.en: Wildlife refers to animals and plants that live and grow in natural conditions.

words.ex: The zebra runs fast in the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 斑马在草原上跑得很快。
words.en: A zebra is an African wild horse with black-and-white stripes.

chapters.name: Unit 7 Part II Lesson A New Words and Expressions

words.ex: She put the apples in a plastic container.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个塑料容器里。
words.en: A container is something such as a box or bottle that is used to hold or store things in.

words.tr: n. 迪吉里杜管（澳洲土著人的乐器）
words.ex: He plays the didgeridoo at the festival.
words.ex_cn: 他在音乐节上演奏迪吉里杜管。
words.en: A wind instrument developed by Indigenous Australians of northern Australia, traditionally made from a hollowed-out tree trunk and producing a deep, resonant sound.

words.ex: He plays the drum in a band.
words.ex_cn: 他在乐队里打鼓。
words.en: A drum is a musical instrument consisting of a skin stretched tightly over a round frame. You play it by hitting it with sticks or with your hands.

words.tr:
n. 街舞；嘻哈文化
adj. 嘻哈的；嘻哈文化的
words.ex: He practices hip-hop every evening after school.
words.ex_cn: 他每天放学后都练习街舞。
words.en: Hip-hop is a cultural movement that began in the 1970s among African Americans and Latino youths in New York City, encompassing music, dance, art, and fashion.

words.ex: He plays jazz on the piano every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上用钢琴演奏爵士乐。
words.en: Jazz is a type of music of black American origin characterized by improvisation, syncopation, and usually a regular or forceful rhythm, emerging at the beginning of the 20th century.

words.ex: He traveled to Mongolia last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了蒙古。
words.en: A country in East Asia, known for its vast, rugged expanses and nomadic culture.

words.ex: The bridge is made of steel.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用钢建造的。
words.en: Steel is a very strong metal made mainly from iron. It is used for making many things such as bridges, buildings, and vehicles.

words.tr: phrase. 特立尼达和多巴哥（中美洲国家）
words.ex: She lives in Trinidad and Tobago.
words.ex_cn: 她住在特立尼达和多巴哥。
words.en: A country consisting of two main islands, Trinidad and Tobago, located in the Caribbean Sea, known for its diverse culture, Carnival, and as the birthplace of steelpan music.

words.tr: phrase. 马头琴（一种蒙古族拉弦乐器，因琴头雕刻成马头形状而得名）
words.ex: He plays the horsehead violin at traditional festivals.
words.ex_cn: 他在传统节日上演奏马头琴。
words.en: A stringed instrument played by bowing, with a horse's head carved into its neck.

words.ex: He sat on a wooden chair.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在一张木制椅子上。
words.en: Made of wood; lacking ease or grace.

chapters.name: Unit 7 Part II Lesson B New Words and Expressions

words.ex: The doctor prescribed a drug for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他开了一种治疗头痛的药物。
words.en: A drug is a substance which is used to treat an illness, relieve a symptom, or modify a chemical process in the body for a specific purpose.

words.ex: He plays the guitar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天弹吉他。
words.en: A guitar is a musical instrument with six strings that you play by plucking or strumming the strings.

words.ex: He went on vacation to Hawaii last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去夏威夷度假了。
words.en: Hawaii is a state of the United States in the central Pacific Ocean comprising the Hawaiian Islands. It is known for its tropical climate, diverse natural scenery, and unique culture.

words.ex: We recycle plastic bottles every week.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周回收塑料瓶。
words.en: To recycle means to process used materials so that they can be used again.

words.ex: He is a songwriter who writes happy songs.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位创作快乐歌曲的作曲家。
words.en: A songwriter is a person who writes the words or the music, or both, for songs.

words.ex: She tied the box with a thin string.
words.ex_cn: 她用一根细线把盒子绑了起来。
words.en: A string is a thin piece of rope or cord, or a series of things connected together.

words.tr: n. 尤克里里琴（夏威夷的四弦琴，等于 ukelele）
words.ex: He plays the ukulele every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上弹尤克里里。
words.en: A small, four-stringed guitar originating from Hawaii.

chapters.name: Unit 7 Part III New Words and Expressions

words.ex: He flipped through the album with old photos.
words.ex_cn: 他翻看着装满旧照片的相册。
words.en: An album is a collection of several pieces of music, songs, or photographs that are intended to form a single item.

words.tr: n. 巴加莫约（坦桑尼亚的一个城市）
words.ex: He visited Bagamoyo last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了巴加莫约。
words.en: A coastal city in Tanzania, historically a significant trading port and starting point for caravans.

words.ex: The farmer feeds his cattle every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂他的牛。
words.en: Cattle are large domesticated animals that are kept on farms for their milk or meat.

words.ex: The herder walks with his sheep every morning.
words.ex_cn: 牧民每天早上带着他的羊群走路。
words.en: A herder is a person who looks after a herd of animals, especially sheep or cattle.

words.ex: My brother's son is my nephew.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟的儿子是我的侄子。
words.en: A nephew is a son of one's sibling or sibling-in-law.

words.tr: n. 生产者；制造商；制片人；
words.ex: The farmer is a producer of milk.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民是牛奶的生产者。
words.en: A producer is a person or company that makes or grows things, or a person who controls and organizes the making of a film, play, or television or radio programme.

words.tr: v. 促进；推动；宣传；推销；
words.ex: Exercise can promote good health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进健康。
words.en: To promote means to help something to happen, develop, or increase, or to raise someone to a higher position or rank.

words.tr: n. 坦桑尼亚（非洲东部国家）
words.ex: He traveled to Tanzania last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了坦桑尼亚。
words.en: A country in East Africa known for its vast wilderness areas, including the plains of Serengeti National Park, a safari mecca populated by the 'big five' game (elephant, lion, leopard, buffalo, rhino), and Kilimanjaro National Park, home to Africa's highest mountain.

words.ex: My family follows the tradition of eating dumplings on New Year's Eve.
words.ex_cn: 我的家庭遵循除夕吃饺子的传统。
words.en: A tradition is a custom or belief that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people.

words.tr: n. 世界音乐艺术节（World of Music, Arts and Dance）
words.ex: They went to Womad to listen to world music.
words.ex_cn: 他们去Womad听世界音乐。
words.en: An annual international festival celebrating world music and arts, originally held in the UK.

chapters.name: Unit 8 Part II Lesson A New Words and Expressions

words.tr:
adv. 单独；独自；
adj. 独自的；孤独的；
words.ex: He walked alone in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他独自在公园里散步。
words.en: If you are alone, you are not with any other people.

words.ex: She moved to Australia last year.
words.ex_cn: 她去年搬到了澳大利亚。
words.en: A country comprising the mainland of the Australian continent, the island of Tasmania, and numerous smaller islands.

words.tr:
v. 有益于；有助于；
n. 利益；好处；
words.ex: Exercise benefits your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有益于你的健康。
words.en: A benefit is something that helps you or improves your life in some way.

words.ex: He sat on the couch and watched TV.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在沙发上看电视。
words.en: A couch is a long, comfortable seat for two or more people to sit on. It is also used to refer to a piece of furniture designed for lying down or sleeping.

words.tr: n. （校外）学生宿舍；旅社；招待所；
words.ex: The students live in a cheap hostel near the university.
words.ex_cn: 学生们住在大学附近的一家便宜的学生宿舍里。
words.en: A hostel is a budget-oriented, shared-room accommodation that attracts a diverse clientele, including backpackers, students, and travelers seeking an economical place to stay.

words.ex: He bought fresh vegetables from the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他从本地市场买了新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: Something that is local relates to a particular area or to the area where you live.

words.tr: adj. 负面的；消极的；否定的；
words.ex: The news had a negative effect on the market.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻对市场产生了负面影响。
words.en: If someone is negative or has a negative attitude, they consider only the bad aspects of a situation, rather than the good ones.

words.tr: n. 建立人际关系网；网络化；
words.ex: He went to the party for networking.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加聚会是为了建立人际关系网。
words.en: The process of interacting with others to exchange information and develop professional or social contacts.

words.ex: He values his privacy and doesn't share personal info online.
words.ex_cn: 他重视自己的隐私，不在网上分享个人信息。
words.en: The state or condition of being free from being observed or disturbed by other people.

words.tr: phrase. 赞成与反对；正面与反面；利弊
words.ex: We listed the pros and cons before making a decision.
words.ex_cn: 我们在做决定之前列出了利弊。
words.en: The advantages and disadvantages of something, especially something that you are considering doing.

words.ex: The site of the old church is now a park.
words.ex_cn: 旧教堂的位置现在是一个公园。
words.en: A site is a piece of ground that is used for a particular purpose or where a particular thing happens.

words.ex: Social problems affect many families.
words.ex_cn: 社会问题影响许多家庭。
words.en: Social means relating to society or to the way society is organized.

words.tr: phrase. 沙发客旅行；借宿沙发旅行（一种通过网络平台免费借住他人沙发以节省住宿费用的旅行方式）
words.ex: He is couch surfing across Europe this summer.
words.ex_cn: 他今年夏天正在欧洲各地通过沙发冲浪旅行。
words.en: Couch surfing refers to the practice of moving from one friend's house to another, sleeping in whatever spare space is available, floor or couch, generally staying a few days before moving on to another house.

words.tr: adj. 使人不舒服的；不自在的；
words.ex: The chair is uncomfortable to sit on.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子坐起来让人不舒服。
words.en: If you are uncomfortable, you are slightly worried or embarrassed, and not relaxed and confident.

chapters.name: Unit 8 Part II Lesson B New Words and Expressions

words.ex: He uses a digital watch to tell time.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块数字手表看时间。
words.en: Digital systems, devices, or technology use electronic signals that are represented by the numbers 1 and 0, indicating 'on' or 'off'.

words.ex: The movie was horrible and made me scared.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很恐怖，让我害怕。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as horrible, you mean they are very unpleasant or bad.

words.tr: n. 游牧民；流浪者；游牧生活；流浪生活
words.ex: The nomad walks with his sheep across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 游牧民带着他的羊群穿越沙漠。
words.en: A nomad is someone who has no permanent home and moves according to the seasons from place to place in search of food, water, and grazing land.

words.tr: phrase. 一刹那；极短的时间
words.ex: He made the decision in a split second.
words.ex_cn: 他在一瞬间做出了决定。
words.en: A split second is an extremely short period of time.

chapters.name: Unit 8 Part III New Words and Expressions

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.ex: He traveled to Bhutan last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了不丹。
words.en: A country in South Asia, located at the eastern end of the Himalayas, known for its monasteries, fortresses, and dramatic landscapes.

words.ex: We celebrate my birthday with cake and friends.
words.ex_cn: 我们用蛋糕和朋友庆祝我的生日。
words.en: To celebrate means to mark a special day, event, or occasion with festivities or ceremonies. It can also mean to praise or honor someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 有挑战性的； v. 提出挑战；“challenge”的现在分词；
words.ex: The math problem was challenging.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很有挑战性。
words.en: If you describe something as challenging, you mean that it tests your ability and determination and that you need to work hard to deal with it or achieve it.

words.ex: He climbed the Himalaya Mountains last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天攀登了喜马拉雅山脉。
words.en: The Himalaya Mountains are a mountain range in Asia separating the plains of the Indian subcontinent from the Tibetan Plateau. The range has many of Earth's highest peaks, including the highest, Mount Everest.

words.ex: His motivation is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助他人。
words.en: Motivation is the enthusiasm or reason for doing something.

words.ex: The children built a mound of sand at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海滩上堆了一个沙土墩。
words.en: A mound is a large pile of earth or stones; it can also refer to the action of piling up earth or stones.

words.tr: phrase. 珠穆朗玛峰（世界最高峰）
words.ex: He climbed mount qomolangma last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天登上了珠穆朗玛峰。
words.en: Mount Qomolangma, known in the West as Mount Everest, is the Earth's highest mountain above sea level, located in the Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas.

words.ex: The children played on the slope behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在房子后面的斜坡上玩耍。
words.en: A slope is a surface that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

words.tr: v. 幸存；生存；存活；艰难挺过；
words.ex: He survived the accident with minor injuries.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中幸存下来，只有轻微受伤。
words.en: If you survive in a dangerous situation, you continue to live or exist in spite of it.

words.tr:
n. 艰苦跋涉；
v. 长途跋涉；
words.ex: The trek across the mountains took five days.
words.ex_cn: 穿越群山的艰苦跋涉花了五天时间。
words.en: A trek is a long and often difficult journey, especially one made on foot.

words.ex: The lamb has a woolly coat.
words.ex_cn: 这只小羊有毛茸茸的毛。
words.en: Something that is woolly is made of wool or looks like wool. It can also mean not clear or not precise.

words.ex: The yak is grazing on the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 牦牛正在山上吃草。
words.en: A yak is a large domesticated wild ox with shaggy hair, humped shoulders, and large horns, used in Tibet as a pack animal and for its milk, meat, and hide.
